Trace, implement and test: Alternate Add Sub

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
public class AlternateAddSub {
    public int AddSub(int input1,int input2){
        int result = input1;
        int check = 0;

        if (input2 == 1) check = 1;

        for (int i = input1 - 1, j = 0; i >= 1; i--, j++) {
            if (j % 2 == check) result += i;
            else result -= i;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
